question: The Winter Youth Olympic Games 2024 will be held in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangwon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The fourth edition of the Winter Youth Olympic Games** **2024** will be held in **Gangwon** province in the cities of **Pyeongchang and Gangneung (Republic of Korea).**
 
• The 2018 Olympic Winter Games 2018 also held in the same city.
 
• The motto of the 4th Edition is **" Grow Together, Shine Together"**.
 
• The games are scheduled to be held between **19 January and 2 February 2024**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 2022 Winter Olympic Games will be held in **Beijing**.

 
 
• The official Mascot of the 2022 Winter Olympics Games is **Bing Dwen**.
 
• The 2024 Summer Olympics is scheduled to take place from 26 July to 11 August 2024 in **Paris, France**.
 
• Olympics 2020 was held in **Tokyo, Japan** from 23 July to 8 August 2021.
 
• The motto of the 2020 Olympics was **United by Emotion**.
 
• The **United States** topped the tally with a total of **113 medals**.
 
• **India** ranked 48th with a total of **7 Medals (1 Gold, 2 Silver and 4 Bronze)**.
